headline: Every side in the conference has now scored
dek: Slippery Rock had not scored before Saturday; then they put four past District of Columbia, while West Chester's first goal of the season came the same afternoon at Wilmington. West Chester have yet to win or lose; Slippery Rock have already done both.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals still sit at one end: Millersville have outscored Gannon and East Stroudsburg together, while the bottom of the chart has filled in and no programme is now without a goal.

wire.line: Millersville have scored fifteen and conceded three, and all three of the season's box-score gaps are theirs.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd's visit to District of Columbia is the one date on the record that has passed with no result, and it is Shepherd's alone; no final is missing its score.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: California (Pa.) have conceded twelve goals, more than any other programme has let in, and scored five.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bloomsburg's ten goals have come from eight different scorers, and their one defeat was at Frostburg State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd are unbeaten, with Aidan Houck making fifteen saves and conceding three across their matches.

last_match.line: Pitt-Johnstown's first home match of the season and their first defeat; their only previous result was a win at Chestnut Hill.

next_match.line: Gannon have won every match since losing their opener at home to Lake Erie; this is their last before conference play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
